Name: Buford
Dialog: Sorry we're late. We went through the car wash 13 times with my Crazy Uncle Oslo.

Name: Ferb
Dialog: Sick.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: No worries. We were busy doing chores all day anyway.

Name: Buford
Dialog: You guys do chores?! I'd think you'd build a small army of drones to do the work for ya!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Well, yes. Yes, we did.

Name: Buford
Dialog: That reminds me, I could use a little help with my chore!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Baljeet and I tried to untangle all these Christmas lights, but it was to no avail.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Buford, why are there so... many?

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, ya see, every year, my mom pays Uncle Oslo...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (voiceover) ...to string up our Christmas lights, but she always forgets to take 'em down! So, year after year, he hangs up more, until...

Name: Buford
Dialog: (voiceover) So now we need a new garage.

Name: Isabella
Dialog: Perhaps your drones could help us untangle this?

Name: Phineas
Dialog: You bet! And when we're done, let's use them to put on a light show!

Name: Phineas
Dialog: Hey, where's Baljeet?

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: It is so Christmasy in there!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So, dinner with both our dads tonight.

Name: Monty
Dialog: What could go wrong?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, it's not like they're sworn enemies who will disown us when they find out we've been dating.

Name: Vanessa and Monty
Dialog: Oh, wait. They are! (They laugh.)

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Yeah, I got a bad feeling about this.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Your pessimism is very attractive.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: You save that sweet talk for tonight.

Name: Monty
Dialog: Conserving sweet talk. See ya there.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Hey, Dad, almost ready for dinner?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: You bet! I've been rehearsing my chitchat intimidation tactics all morning. Have you told him I'm evil?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs and facepalms) Yes, Dad. Just, please, be on your best behavior tonight, and promise me no inators at the dinner table.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Okay, okay, I promise.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: But she didn't mention the table itself being an inator!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Nice loophole, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I know, right? Behold, my Tableturn-inator! Wait, uh... it's actually just a diagram. I put the real table in the restaurant... (stammers) "Behold, this diagram of my Tableturn-inator" is what I'm trying to say. So y'know how these fancy restaurants are so overpriced and they serve these tiny little portions? Well, with this, if I sit in the red chair and spin the table, I'll get all the good food!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Your pettiest scheme yet, sir!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I try. I try.

Name: Baljeet
Dialog: I never knew this song had another verse.

Name: Buford
Dialog: Well, it was never apropos until now.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: All systems go, Ferb!

Name: Isabella
Dialog: It's getting dark. Doesn't anyone care where Perry is?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (applauding) Delightful entrance, Agent P! Anyhoo, our intel says that Doof is dining in Danville tonight, which, you know, now that I think about it, sounds pretty harmless. I, too, have dinner reservations of my own.

Name: Carl
Dialog: As do I, sir.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Nobody cares, Carl! (to Agent P) I'm meeting my son's girlfriend for the first time. Why don't you join us, Agent P?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry I couldn't make it to your Brazilian jiu-jitsu competition, Stace. It was chore day.

Name: Stacy
Dialog: It's okay! It's going great!

Name: Candace
Dialog: You go, girl! I haven't seen the boys building anything, so it's pretty chill here. But I feel kinda unfulfilled not having to bust them.

Name: Phineas
Dialog: (offscreen) Who's ready for the light show?

Name: Candace
Dialog: Sorry, Stacy, that's my cue! (hangs up and runs up to the window) I'm back in business, baby!

Name: Hostess
Dialog: Right this way.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Wait, Carl? What in blazes are you doing here?! And who are these guys?!

Name: Carl
Dialog: Oh, we're here for the 2-for-1 sidekick special... (does a secret handshake with Norm and the other guy) ...'cause, y'know, we're all sidekicks.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Doofenshmirtz?! Are you here to ruin my classy evening out with my son and his new girlfriend?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, don't be silly, Francis. I'm also here for a classy dinner with my daughter and her new boyf— (recognizes Monty) Wait a second! (to Vanessa) "Nostril Boy"?! Is he your new boyfriend?!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (sighs) His name is Monty, Dad. Look, if we told you the truth, neither of you would have come. Let's try and be civilized and enjoy ourselves?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: This smells like a setup. Carl, consider yourself back on the clock. Pull up a chair.

Name: Carl
Dialog: Yes, sir. Sorry, Dexter.

Name: Dexter
Dialog: (speaking with a lateral lisp) It's okay. I have to go anyway.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (quietly, to Norm) That's my chair! The one with the foot control! (out loud) Uh, Francis, maybe you'd like this chair with the sleek upholstery.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I'm perfectly comfortable here.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I-I-I-I-I-I must insist.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (crosses his arms) No! It's mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, mine!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, mine!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: [groans] Here we go.

Name: Hostess
Dialog: Your usual table, sir?

Name: Hostess
Dialog: Oh, you'll be joining friends? Very good, sir. Right this way.

Name: Girl at Bar 1
Dialog: Hey, isn't that that guy you gave your number to?

Name: Girl at Bar 2
Dialog: Yeah, he hasn't called, but a girl can dream.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, you're in on this, too? I am so out of the loop!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He's my guest and now my backup. No son of mine will date the daughter of my mortal enemy!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, yeah? Well, no daughter of mine will date the son of my— Y-You get the idea. I'm just flipping what you said.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Vanessa Dad. Just, please sit down.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: So... this is nice, right?

Name: Rinaldo
Dialog: Welcome, I'm Rinaldo. Enjoy our signature dining experience.

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (awkwardly, to Monty) I... hear they have great gelato.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Perry the Platypus, could... could... could we have a word in my, uh, office?

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm just trying to figure out how to get out of here without ruining Vanessa's night. Food poisoning? No, no. Fake alien invasio— No, no, it's... (He falls backwards accidentally flushing the toilet he is seated on.) I'm just spitballing here. I'm spitballing. Ooh, ooh! Perry the Platypus, you stay here, and when I go in there, you call me with an "emergency". All right? Yeah, yeah, that'll do.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Agent P, any intel? Doofenshmirtz is clearly using his daughter as a pawn to infiltrate O.W.C.A.

Name: Norm
Dialog: She's clearly out of his league.

Name: Monty
Dialog: We should have done tacos.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: I don't know what he sees in her.

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think they look cute together.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Y'know, pink is not Francis's color.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: He's making a huge mistake.

Name: Rinaldo
Dialog: Girl better wake up!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Nostril Guy? Is she for real? Nostril Guy!

Name: Uncle Oslo
Dialog: Have you tried takin' him through a car wash?

Name: Norm
Dialog: I'm not programmed to understand love.

Name: Doofenshmirtz and Major Monogram
Dialog: This is an absolutely unacceptable situation!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Who said that?! Doof, is that you?!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Who? Not me. I gotta go. Bye!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm stealing your seat, Francis! You can sit in mine.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Why, I oughta... Hold me back, Carl!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Hold me back, Norm!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: (grunts) Hold me back less! Hold me back l...

Name: Rinaldo
Dialog: Dinner is served.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Time to turn the tables.

Name: Rinaldo
Dialog: And for the grand finale...

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Great googly moogly! Heh. Y'know, Vanessa, this reminds me of this one Fourth of July when Monty had a firecracker shoot right at—

Name: Monty
Dialog: (embarrassed) Dad!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Wait! I wanna hear this!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Aw, yeah! Get in my tummy! That is all mine!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, it's mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, mine!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mine!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mine!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Mine!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Mine!

Name: Perry
Dialog: (chatters a long impassioned speech)

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'll be honest, I didn't understand anything you said. But look at us. Who are we to stand in the way of young love? (to Francis) I'm sorry for being a giant man-baby.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: You're not the man-baby. I am.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: I'm the man-baby!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, I am!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I am!

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: No, I am!

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: No, I am!

Name: Norm
Dialog: Alert! Alert!

Name: Man
Dialog: Ooh, this is immersive!

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: Dad, what did you do?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Quick, get on the table!

Name: Carl
Dialog: I think I'm gonna be sick!

Name: Buford
Dialog: Hey, guys, the only thing that would make this show better? Popcorn!

Name: Candace
Dialog: I'll take that! Time to shine a light on this bust!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Wait 'til Mom gets a load of this! (laughs and goes back inside)

Name: Linda
Dialog: Candace, it's the climax of my movie! This better be quick!

Name: Candace
Dialog: (dragging her mom off the couch) It is! Wait till you see the sky! Come on!

Name: Candace
Dialog: Come on! Just look up!

Name: Linda
Dialog: Oh, Candace, it really is a lovely moon, but it's not like it was going to disappear. Couldn't it have waited till after the movie?

Name: Candace
Dialog: But, but-but-but, but...

Name: Zoetrope Deity
Dialog: It is not your time. Oh. Sorry, I thought you were a zoetrope. Never mind.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (to Doof) Hmm, about the, uh, hugging when we were at death's door. I wasn't myself back there.

Name: Doofenshmirtz
Dialog: Oh, totally. So, you know, for continuity's sake, (hold out his hand) enemies?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (shakes Doof's hand) Enemies.

Name: Monty
Dialog: You okay, Nessa?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: (removing a shrimp from her hair) Yeah. Well, I suppose that could have gone worse. We like each other, right? It's not just that we enjoy messing with our dads?

Name: Monty
Dialog: Can't it be both?

Name: Vanessa
Dialog: It can be both.

Name: Rinaldo
Dialog: Here is the bill. Plus, damáges.

Name: Rinaldo
Dialog: Don't forget to tip.

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: (looking at the bill) Wait, what is this?

Name: Major Monogram
Dialog: Curse you, Heinz Doofenshmirtz!
